name: Tachibana Makoto
source:
Makoto is Haruka's best friend, and is also a second-year in the same class as Haruka. Unlike Haruka, he is more outgoing and often speaks up for Haruka. He is nice and considerate to others. However, he is weak-hearted and gets scared easily.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free!_(anime)]Wikipedia[/url]]
